name: Kansas Flavor
old_description: Our products are available throughout the state of Kansas. All of our products are home made, and pack amazing flavor. Have a look at some recipes for each of our products, and find your local Kansas retailer!
about:
Kansas Flavor operates from Valley Center, Kansas, producing a line of homemade food products sold through retailers across the state. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in the available information.

The product lineup includes eight items: Bread & Butter Jalapenos, Garlic Ranch Marinade, Jalapeno Mustard, Rub It Raw, Seasoning Salt, Cajun Marinade, Cajun Seasoning, and Beef Jerky (implied by retailer Beef Jerky Unlimited). All products are described as homemade. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not stated.

The company serves the retail food market in Kansas, with products stocked at over twenty independent retailers including All Things BBQ and Spice Merchant in Wichita, Richard's Cold Storage in Valley Center, Indian Hills Meat and Produce, and numerous specialty meat markets, antique shops, and farm stores across cities such as Hutchinson, Manhattan, Topeka, Garden City, and Olathe.

The company emphasizes that its products are homemade and pack "amazing flavor," and it provides recipes for each product on its website. No further differentiation claims or origin story are provided in the source material.
type_evidence: All of our products are home made, and pack amazing flavor.
